per_asset_class_predictor.rationale: This is the central scoring entry point for asset class predictions, called during every scoring batch.
per_asset_class_predictor.downside: Risk of overloading the main prediction loop with untested logic.

concentration_enhancer.rationale: Concentration logic fits naturally in portfolio weight optimization as a post-processing step.
concentration_enhancer.downside: May interfere with existing risk parity constraints.

drift_circuit_breaker.rationale: Drift detection is already centralized here, making it the logical place to trigger circuit breakers.
drift_circuit_breaker.downside: Risk of false positives if thresholds are not tuned properly.

circuit_breaker_namespace_plan.stale_state_leak_prevention_rule: ttl_seconds=3600 on each top-level namespace, expiry → ignored
